grid.layout_notes: Collapsing Mine 6-wide; starts 3 active rows, expands to 6. Official rowsReels 6-6-6-6-6-6. Lucky Wagon opens 2/3/4 rows initially (4 with 6 Bonus).

win_system.notes: 46,656 ways at full 6-row open (6^6). Ways scale with active rows.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: Collapsing Mine: wins paid and removed; tumble; +1 active row per collapse up to 6. Also triggered by xBomb, Wild Mining, or xHole.

other.name: Ice Buried Features
other.how_it_works: Ice may hide Wild, xSplit, Win Multiplier (2x-100x), xHole, Bonus, or 2x2 Max. Inactive until ice removed by exploding xBomb; xSplit reveals contents except win multiplier. Max awards max win when all ice cleared from the symbol.

other.name: xBomb Wild
other.how_it_works: Wild except Bonus; explodes adjacents (not Bonus); +win mult by its value for next collapse; skips explode when Wild Mining triggers.

other.name: xHole
other.how_it_works: Pays wins first; draws only regulars, scatters them as size 1-3 splits; leaves empty space triggering collapse. Multiple xHole increase symbol size.

other.name: xSplit
other.how_it_works: Splits all other symbols on its reel (doubling). Bonus/xSplit/xHole not split; after activate become regulars. Ice hit by split removed on collapse.

other.name: Wild Mining
other.how_it_works: 3-6 same symbols align H or V with no win, no active xHole, no active xBomb: remove them, place 1-4 Wilds in middle; explode non-Bonus/Ice-Buried above bar; Ice Buried reveal on collapse.

wilds.name: xBomb Wild
wilds.behavior: Substitutes except Bonus; explode adjacents; +mult by bomb value for next collapse.

wilds.name: Wild (mining / ice)
wilds.behavior: Created by Wild Mining or revealed from ice.

scatters.name: Bonus
scatters.behavior: 3/4/5 trigger Lucky Wagon with 2/3/4 rows open; 6 Bonus triggers Lucky Wagon with Persistent Dwarf on first spin and 4 rows open.

multipliers.name: Collapse / ice win multiplier
multipliers.behavior: xBomb increases win mult for next collapse; ice can hold 2x, 3x, 5x, 10x, 20x, 50x, or 100x.

specials.name: Max (ice)
specials.behavior: 2x2 in ice; clearing all ice from it awards Fire In The Bowl (70,000x).

specials.name: Lucky Wagon coins / enhancers / Dwarfs
specials.behavior: Coins times bet; top enhancers (Coin values, Multipliers, Dynamite, Persistent Dynamite, xHole, Evil Dwarf, Persistent Dwarf). Persistent Dwarf collects all values each spin; Evil Dwarf Golden Spin reactivates coins. xHole in bonus awards 3 Frozen Wagon Spins then resumes Lucky Wagon reset to 3.

base_game_loop.summary: Collapse spin from 3 to 6 rows with xBomb, xSplit, ice-buried features, Wild Mining, and xHole. Optional Gamble on wins of at least 5x for Lucky Wagon levels. 3-6 Bonus to Lucky Wagon (3-spin reset on coins) with enhancers; xHole may insert Frozen Wagon. Buys: Guaranteed Dwarf 4,000x, Evil Dwarf Forever 700x, Golden Nugget 7,000x; boosters 2x/5x/5x.

phases.name: Configure boosters
phases.what_happens: Optional Nolimit Boosters: Bonus on reel 2 (2x), at least 3 Bonus in ice (5x), or all 6 rows active (5x).

phases.name: Collapse loop
phases.what_happens: Pay wins; tumble; xBomb/xSplit/xHole/Wild Mining/ice reveals; open rows to 6.
phases.state_changes: Rows/mult may rise; ice features may activate

phases.name: Gamble / Lucky Wagon check
phases.what_happens: If win at least 5x and Gamble on, option to gamble for Lucky Wagon levels. Else 3-6 Bonus enter Lucky Wagon.

base_game_loop.win_evaluation: Wins paid before each collapse; xBomb mult applies to next collapse; Max ice awards 70,000x when fully cleared.
base_game_loop.notes: From official CMS feature blurbs on nolimitcity.com/games/fire-in-the-hole-3 (no GameSheet PDF linked on page).

modes.name: Lucky Wagon Spins
modes.trigger: 3, 4, or 5 Bonus (2/3/4 rows open); or 6 Bonus (Persistent Dwarf first spin, 4 rows open); or via Gamble / buys.
modes.spins_awarded: Starts at 3; resets to 3 whenever a coin lands.
modes.retrigger: Coin landing resets to 3. xHole transforms to 1x coin, awards 3 Frozen Wagon Spins, then resumes Lucky Wagon with spin count reset to 3.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Persistent Dynamite / Persistent Dwarf can stick; Collect chests via Dynamite.
modes.progressive_state: Coin values accumulate times bet via enhancers; Multiplier enhancer multiplies coins/dwarf/persistent dynamite below.
modes.end_condition: Spins hit 0 with no coin reset, or Fire In The Bowl 70,000x.

phases.name: Enter
phases.what_happens: Open 2/3/4 rows (4 with 6 Bonus); spins=3; enable enhancer row.

phases.name: Collect
phases.what_happens: Coins trigger enhancers; Dynamite/Dwarf/xHole/Frozen Wagon as applicable.

modes.effects: Hold-and-win with reset-3, enhancers, Persistent/Evil Dwarf, Frozen Wagon via xHole, 70,000x cap.

modes.name: Frozen Wagon Spins
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Existing coins remain; top enhancer row coins-only.
modes.progressive_state: All existing coins collect enhancer coin values and add to existing values.
modes.end_condition: 3 Frozen spins complete; then resume Lucky Wagon with count reset to 3.

phases.name: Frozen collect
phases.what_happens: 3 spins; enhancers are coins only; existing coins add enhancer values.

modes.effects: Interrupts Lucky Wagon; boosts coin values; resumes Lucky Wagon at 3 spins.
